# `aitbc wallet bridge settlements`

List exchange-settlement ledger rows on the hub wallet service (admin-keyed — CLI-1).

## Usage

```bash
aitbc wallet bridge settlements [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--state` | text | — | no | Filter by settlement status (needs_review, settled, refunded, ...) |
| `--kind` | choice | — | no | Filter by settlement kind |
| `--limit` | integer | `50` | no | Max rows (server caps at 500) |
| `--hub-url` | text | — | no | Hub wallet-service base URL — bare origin, path is stripped (default: configured wallet daemon) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc wallet bridge settlements
```
